projectDesc.p: This TEI document is a derived machine-only view of Cora Histórico Digital. Internal CHD data remain canonical; OCR is preserved without silent correction or linguistic normalization.

editorialDecl.p: Only machine_accepted alphabetical records are projected as lexical entries. machine_uncertain and machine_rejected candidates are retained as residual documentary items in back matter and are never promoted to entries.
